most_similar_reason: Candidate 8 is plainly a variant of the same epic—divine incarnation as a prince, winning a princess at an archery/bow contest, forest exile with a loyal brother, the spurned demoness, the abduction of the wife by the multi-headed demon king of an island realm, the monkey allies who find her, and the final victory and homecoming.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 9 is least similar because it is a bare notice about an ancestral/creator figure who makes humans from reeds and then forgets them, with no hero, no bride, no exile, abduction, or battle.
